senses.gloss:
मितध्वज

MITADHVAJA . A King of videha. According to bhāgavata mitadhvaja was the son of dharmadhvaja janaka.

मित्र

MITRA .1) General information. One of the twelve Sūryas. The twelve Sūryas born to aditi of Kaśyapaprajāpati are viṣṇu, śakra, aryamā, dhātā, tvaṣṭā, pūṣā, vivasvān, savitā, mitra, varuṇa, bhaga and aṁśa. (Chapter 15, aṁśa 1, viṣṇu purāṇa).

mitrāvaruṇas are two devatās of great intimacy. They are always found together. If you pray to mitrāvaruṇas you will get plenty of rains. (Śūkta 2, Anuvāka 1, Maṇḍala 1, ṛgveda).

See para 2 under agastya to understand the story of how mitrāvaruṇas became the father of agastya.
2) Other details.
(i) mitra came and stood in the sky at the time of the birth of arjuna. (Śloka 66, Chapter 122, Ādi Parva).
(ii) mitra was one among those sent by indra to fight against kṛṣṇa and arjuna at the time of the burning of the forest Khāṇḍava. (Śloka 36, Chapter 226 Ādi Parva).
(iii) mitra was a member of the indra sabhā. (Śloka 21, Chapter 7, Sabhā Parva).(iv) He presented two Pārṣadas named suvrata and satyasandha to subrahmaṇya. (Śloka 41, Chapter 45, śalya Parva).

मित्रा

MITRĀ . A female companion of pārvatī. (Śloka 41, Chapter 231, Vana Parva).

मित्रदेव

MITRADEVA . Brother of suśarmā, King of Trigartta. arjuna killed him in the great battle. (Śloka 3, Chapter 27, karṇa Parva).

मित्रधर्मा

MITRADHARMĀ . Son of the agni called pāñcajanya, (Śloka 12, Chapter 220, Vana Parva).

मित्रघ्न

MITRAGHNA . A demon who fought on the side of rāvaṇa in the rāma-rāvaṇa battle. śrī rāma killed this demon. (Chapter 34, Verse 27, yuddha Kāṇḍa, vālmīki rāmāyaṇa).

मित्रज्ञ

MITRAJÑA . Son of the agni named pāñcajanya. He was one of the five Devavināyakas. (Śloka 12, Chapter 220, Vana Parva).

मित्रसख

MITRASAKHA (mitrasaha) . A King of the Solar dynasty. He was known as kalmāṣapāda also. (See under kalmāṣapāda).

मित्रसेन

MITRASENA . A King who fought on the side of the kauravas in the great battle. arjuna killed him. (Śloka 20, Chapter 19, karṇa Parva).

मित्रवान् १

MITRAVĀN I . Son of the agni named pāñcajanya. He was one of the Pāñcadevavināyakas. (Śloka 12, Chapter 220, Vana Parva).

मित्रवान् २

MITRAVĀN II . An ascetic who lived in the city of Saupura. He acquired complete peace of mind by reading the second Chapter of the gītā sitting in a śiva temple. Once a brahmin of name devaśarmā approached a sage named Muktakarmā seeking advice to obtain peace of mind. The latter directed devaśarmā to mitravān and mitravān advised him to read the second Chapter of the gītā. (padma purāṇa, uttara Khaṇḍa, 176).

मित्रवर्धन

MITRAVARDHANA . Son of the agni called pāñcajanya. He was one of the Pañcadevavināyakas. (Śloka 12, Chapter 220, Vana Parva).

मित्रवर्मन्

MITRAVARMAN . Brother of suśarmā, King of trigarta. arjuna killed him in the great battle. (Śloka 3, Chapter 27, karṇa Parva).

मित्रावरुणस्

MITRĀVARUṆA(S) . The combined name of two of the dvādaśādityas (twelve Sūryas) mitra and varuṇa. These two are always seen together. agastya and vasiṣṭha were born as sons of mitrāvaruṇa. It was due to a curse by mitrāvaruṇas that urvaśī had to marry King purūravas, a man of the earth. manu had no children and he performed a yāga to placate mitrāvaruṇas. But since there were many faults in the ceremony a girl was born to him. (For details see under ilā, nimi, urvaśī, vasiṣṭha and mitra).

मित्रविन्द

MITRAVINDA . A deva. The havis (clarified butter which is put in the agni called rathantara is intended for this deva. (Śloka 19, Chapter 220, Vana Parva).

मित्रविन्दा

MITRAVINDĀ . Daughter of Śrī Kṛṣṇa's father's sister. Mitravindā's mother's name was rājādhidevī. rājādhidevī, qveen of Avantī, got three children named vinda, anuvinda and mitravindā. In the svayaṁvara mitravindā chose kṛṣṇa as her husband. vinda and anuvinda did not like it and joining the kaurava side fought against kṛṣṇa. But kṛṣṇa defeated them all and took mitravindā to dvārakā. (10th skandha, bhāgavata).

मित्रेयु

MITREYU . A King of the Lunar dynasty. He was the son of divodāsa and father of cyavana.
